text: The project has benefited over 716,000 people, with more than 35 community DRR construction initiatives protecting over 200,000 individuals. It has produced 4,462 IEC materials on earthquake-resistant construction, planted 3,500 native saplings, and provided digitized bundled insurance to over 1,000 households. Eight municipalities have been strengthened, with targets to have over 10 entities adopting DRM policies and training more than 1,000 DRM personnel.

metadata.solution_name: USAID’s Tayar Nepal – Improved Disaster Risk Management Project (Tayar Nepal)
